{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check data types
dtypes = sales_df.dtypes

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()

# Check unique values in 'status' and 'converted'
status_unique = sales_df['status'].unique()
converted_unique = sales_df['converted'].unique()

# Check distribution of converted
converted_counts = sales_df['converted'].value_counts()

# Print findings
print(f"Missing values:\n{missing_values}")
print(f"\nData types:\n{dtypes}")
print(f"\nDuplicates: {duplicates}")
print(f"\nUnique values in 'status': {status_unique}")
print(f"\nUnique values in 'converted': {converted_unique}")
print(f"\nConversion distribution:\n{converted_counts}")"}
